## Change

Describe the user problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue if there is one.

## Validation

State the checks run and their results. Include browser or native evidence for interface changes,
and before/after offline evaluations for agent or context changes.

## Boundaries and rollout

Note migrations, new permissions or external services, compatibility changes, and rollback needs.
Remove this section when it does not apply. Keep credentials, private prompts and unredacted logs
out of the pull request.
